one_line: A wealthy merchant–administrator from 11th-century Lokkigundi, patron of both Jain and Shaiva temples in a bustling trade-town of Karnataka.

appearance.age_look: Late 30s, medium height with a sturdy, well-nourished build suggesting prosperity and responsibility.
appearance.face: Oval face with soft but defined jaw, wheatish-brown complexion, straight nose, neatly groomed short beard and moustache; calm, thoughtful eyes with a composed, dignified default expression.
appearance.hair: Black hair, parted slightly off-center and combed back into a modestly long, smooth style reaching just above the nape; small central tilaka mark on the forehead; wears a simple, fine gold circlet-style headband with a tiny central leaf motif.
appearance.costume: He wears a finely draped white cotton dhoti wrapped to the ankles in a neat north-Karnataka style with a broad maroon border, paired with a fitted, long-sleeved light-cream angiya (upper cloth) that reaches the hips; over this, a soft turmeric-yellow silk uttariya shawl with thin red and green stripes is draped from the left shoulder across the chest and around the back; his feet are in brown leather sandals; he is adorned with a modest but clear gold chain necklace with a small disc pendant, simple gold karnaphoola ear-studs, a narrow gold ring on his right hand, and a dark red cloth girdle at the waist with a small knotted tassel to one side.
appearance.signature: A rectangular palm-leaf document bundle tied with a thin cord, held in his left hand, and a small copper coin held between fingers of his right hand, symbolising his role in inscriptions, trade accounts, and the town’s mint.

ref_desc: The Mahajana of Lakkundi has an oval wheatish face with short beard, black combed-back hair and small tilaka, wearing a white dhoti with maroon border, cream angiya, turmeric-yellow striped shawl, simple gold jewellery, brown sandals, and holding palm-leaf documents and a copper coin in a white, maroon, yellow, brown, and gold palette.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character sheet of the Mahajana of Lakkundi: a late-30s sturdy merchant–administrator with an oval wheatish face, straight nose, calm thoughtful expression, neatly trimmed short beard and moustache, and black hair parted slightly off-center then combed smoothly back to just above the nape, with a small tilaka on his forehead and a thin gold circlet headband with a tiny leaf motif. He wears an era-accurate 11th-century Karnataka outfit: a white cotton dhoti wrapped to the ankles with a broad maroon border, a fitted long-sleeved light-cream angiya upper cloth to the hips, and a turmeric-yellow silk uttariya shawl with thin red and green stripes draped from left shoulder across the chest and around his back. Show a dark red cloth girdle at his waist with a small knotted tassel, simple gold ear-studs, a modest gold chain necklace with a small disc pendant, a narrow gold ring on his right hand, and brown leather sandals on his feet. In his left hand he holds a tied rectangular bundle of palm-leaf documents, and in his right hand he delicately holds a small copper coin, suggesting inscriptions and trade in the town’s mint. Use a clean anime look but keep all garments modest and fully covering, with dominant colours of white, maroon, turmeric yellow, brown, and gold, shown clearly from multiple angles in a neutral, well-lit view.
